name: tables
description: Queryable tables: .ptable datasets that live on your drives like files, with csv/tsv/xlsx viewing, version history and full AI tooling.
help: Tables are .ptable datasets that live on your drives like files: they are indexed, searchable and keep a full version history.
CSV, TSV and XLSX files open in the tables viewer with sort, a SELECT/WITH SQL filter bar and one-way Save as .ptable; .ptable cells edit inline with snapshot-first versions.
Ask the AI to query, edit and reshape tables with the tables.* tools (schema, query_sql, update_rows, add_column) — one answer leaves a single restorable history entry.
Save as .ptable copies a spreadsheet into a 'DocIndex Tables' folder on its drive — copies out of synced trees land in the Personal drive's folder instead — without touching the original.
The tables viewer offers Organize — a previewed plan moving stray tables into their drive's 'DocIndex Tables' folder (explicit Confirm only, never silent) — plus Revert last organize.
